reasoning_content:
Interesting! The password IS valid according to Rails (`valid_password? = true`), and admin is confirmed and administrator. Yet the HTTP login POST failed with "Ungültiger E-Mail oder Benutzer*innenname oder Passwort."

Wait — maybe the login failed because I need to handle the CSRF token properly, or because the app uses a login by "login" field rather than "user[email]". Let me look at the login form field names.

Actually the failure might be due to my curl POST not matching the form fields. Let me inspect the sign_in form.

action.command: cd /tmp && curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in -o si.html; grep -o 'name="[^"]*"' si.html | sort -u | head -30; echo "--- inputs ---"; grep -oE '<input[^>]*>' si.html | head -20

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp && curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in -o si.html; grep -o 'name=\"[^\"]*\"' si.html | sort -u | head -30; echo \"--- inputs ---\"; grep -oE '<input[^>]*>' si.html | head -20", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Inspect sign-in form fields"}
